entities.summary: Robert Daniel Refsnyder is a Korean-American professional baseball outfielder for the Seattle Mariners of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the New York Yankees, Toronto Blue Jays, Tampa Bay Rays, Texas Rangers, Minnesota Twins, and Boston Red Sox.
